title: Synchronous federated learning acceleration method based on model segmentation under edge calculation scene
assignee: Hefei Benyuan Internet Of Things Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Inefficiency and waste of computing resources in synchronous federated learning under edge calculation scene due to difference in computing capabilities among terminal devices.
pse.solution_function: Accelerates synchronous federated learning by segmenting models on each terminal device, calculating the first half part locally, sending the second half part calculation task to a matched edge server, and minimizing the total time for model training through optimized model segmentation strategy and edge server matching strategy.
pse.solution_structure: N terminal devices and m edge servers; each terminal device segments its model into first half part and second half part; edge servers match with terminal devices for computation.
pse.solution_implementation: Model segmentation, edge server matching, local calculation of first half part by terminal device, sending calculation task of second half part to matched edge server, receiving results from edge server, and model optimization based on the results.
pse.effect: Reduction in overall training time of synchronous federated learning, minimizing idle operation, and efficient utilization of computing resources
